nom: VANICREAM Facial Moisturizer Broad Spectrum Mineral SPF 30

avis.texte: Love, dewy satiny gorgeous look to this. And the plumpness hides wrinkles. Love this. The secret is to put on in pea sized amounts. 6-7 peas fit your face and take time to moisturize in it. I do have dry skin. There's no white cast. I use this on my face. Body no.

This is a gorgeous sunscreen. It's heavy and extremely moisturizing, but I found if you put it on in P sized amounts take one P for your cheek another P for your other cheek, etc. And blend it in slowly on each section. Just because it's so moisturizing, that way it makes it less thick and heavy. I think I put about six peas on my face. It has a gorgeous glow to it. It's like a soft, beautiful glow like where did that come from kind of glow. My son was wearing it and I thought wow your skin looks so lovely so I tried it out. If you just like, put a load on your hand and then slap it on your face, I find it doesn't work well that way it's just too much. It works great under makeup. I think it's the ceramides inside it that can make people break out. I used to have a reaction to ceramides before my skin became so dry. But not now as very dry. The secret to use this is putting on in small little section amounts and blended and really really well. However, if you do have oily skin because this is so moisturizing, I don't think this would work for you. It doesn't feel tacky Sensory Wise, But if you were to go up and touch your face, you would know that it was on there. It doesn't like completely blend in where it's never there however, I just keep using it cause I love the little glow it gives, and I love the moisture. I have fair skin so I don't really notice a white cast at all. My son is medium skin and he doesn't have a white cast so that's also a nice thing about this product
This moisturizer is definitely not for oily skin types. It was heavy and greasy looking. If you have dry skin and don't use too much, I think it would be perfect.

avis.titre: the BEST for ultra sensitive skin with rosacea
avis.texte: i have type 1 & type 2 rosacea and this is the only spf i can use actually makes my skin feel and look calmer than if i didn't wear it. wish it was easier to find!! there is a whitecast also.

My face loves this sunscreen and can't tolerate any other. I have rosacea, and this sunscreen even helps calm down my skin after applying it. I'm also acne-prone, and it doesn't break me out. I've tried many sunscreens, and the others i've tried don't compare to this one. Other sunscreens make my skin red, or break me out, or both. This one calms my skin and doesn't break me out. I love it; I've been using it for around 2-3 years now. Cons: White cast that isn't really noticeable on me may be more noticeable for other skin tones, but that's because of the zinc oxide percentage, which I wouldn't change anything because my skin loves it. It can be a bit greasy/dewy, but I just don't need moisturizer in the morning with this which is great.

This sunscreen goes on smooth with a very faint white cast. It's perfect for my sensitive acne prone skin and is my go to wear under makeup or for pool days when I just need solid sun protection. I have yet to get burnt when wearing/reapplying!

It is a good product as far as sunscreen goes but it does not provide ample moisture to dry skin. I like the fact that it doesn't contain parabens and fragrance. To Vanicream: it would be better if you can add moisture to all of your products as it does not offer moisturizer protection.

avis.titre: Please always have this item in stock
avis.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for years. I had a weird skin disease for a 2-3 years and it was really bad. I was allergic to everything. I searched online for the best clean ingredients with mineral spf and it led me to Vanicream. The vanicream daily moisturizer and this facial moisturizer spf has the best clean ingredients. I do have very dry skin and this makes my skin hydrated and glowy, not greasy. Its perfect for under makeup too! I will never use any other brand for SPF.

I could not love this product more. I went through a bout of perioral dermatitis because I was allergic to whatever I was putting on my face before. I added this product to my routine after I found out what the problem was and not only do I no longer have a rash, but this sunscreen adds a dewy finish on top of my daily moisturizer that I get compliments on all the time. this sunscreen is moisturizing so you have to consider that when you're picking a moisturizer and you cannot pick something too thick or else you will break out or look oily. I do not wear skin makeup day today so I can't speak for how this product looks under daily makeup but on occasion, I will add concealer under my eyes and on any blemishes. Otherwise I'll use powder products that look great with this sunscreen. There is not much of a white cast. give it a try!!!
this product aggravated my cystic acne and caused severe breakouts! Could be the squalane. Do not recommend

avis.titre: Rather dry, and stings the eyes
avis.texte: I bought this because the original (non spf) didn't pill my makeup, but I wanted sun protection. This feels thick and dry, which will not work over the winter. And my eyelids are BURNING. I'd read reviews that said it didn't sting, so got excited that this may finally be the sunscreen moisturizer that would work. Unfortunately, not for me. This is definitely a summer cream and not for eye skin, leaving that unprotected.

I've tried literally all the popular sunscreens, from EltaMd to high end luxury brands to clean beauty (Ilia, kosas,etc.), to Korean ones, the Vanicream SPF is by far the best one. It is moisturizing but not oily. The finish is beautiful without white cast! 0 breakouts too. Perfect sunscreen. I finally found the one!

This is the best facial sunscreen. I've been using it for years now. Slight white sheen after initial application but does go away after it absorbs. I pair it with CosRX snail mucin power essence moisturizer. My skin stays looking hydrated and dewy and still feels soft at the end of the day.

avis.titre: My go-to non-nano zinc oxide sunscreen
avis.texte: As goo as it gets on the market for non-nano zinc oxide sunscreens. All truly mineral sunscreen are going to be zinc and have a light cast at minimum. This one is as good as it gets. I love it and I prefer knowing that sunscreen filters aren't getting into my bloodstream.

I bought this when I was struggling with extra dry skin and needed something rich. This did nothing but sat on top of my face and pilled with my other serums I had also bought to help with my dryness. I'm not sure who this would work for to even recommend it but if you do like it, I'm glad it works for you.

I have longstanding facial acne and facial eczema and am in my mid-30's. Finding a non-comedogenic, non irritating, mineral, non-nano SPF facial moisturiser has taken me years to find. I have brown skin and this does not leave a white cast. I feel like a summer of using this product has actually helped heal my skin - it's clearer and smoother than it has been in 10 years. Just perfect. Please never discontinue this product, it is beyond excellent.
I'm surprised so many people are saying this is too greasy. For me it's actually kinda drying despite how thick it is. I'll try to finish it but wouldn't repurchase.

I brought this on vacation as my only moisturizer and I regretted it because of how thick it is. I have oily skin and it just felt really heavy on my face. I was expecting something as light and gentle as the vanicream cleanser but it was definitely a lot thicker than expecting. I would use this as a face sunscreen and for my tattoos, but probably not as a standalone moisturizer.
I purchased this product because my usual was not available and I found it to be even better! Great moisturizer and sunblock in one!
I love Vanicream and have the face wash and moisturizer but this spf and moisturizer blend is too much for the daytime and leaves oily skin greasy.

I really liked that this product did not flair up my eczema and did not sting my eyes. However, for a long period i had breakouts and could not figure out why i was getting these itchy whiteheads and i finally figured out this guy was the culprit. I went a month without using jt and had clear skin two days ago then I decided to use this sunscreen over my Hero green sunscreen (highly recommened for all skin types). I completely broke out again in itchy white heads and cystic acne. Idk what chemical it is but there's something in this product that is not suitable for large pores and acne prone girlies. The regular moisturizer is nice and i honestly thought the sunscreen and moisturizer were similar besides the zinc oxide added but no they are completely different. Try it and see if it works for you but just know that it could break you out. Not a sponsership but the Hero cosmetics sunscreen that has a green tint is the best sunscreen ive ever had. I have combo skin so some days im super dry or some days i am oily and this girl works everday plus it is not heavily fragranced like others

I really wanted to like this sunscreen since i have had good luck with other vanicream products since they are for sensitive skin. However, this made my face super itchy and it was so distracting. This may not work with everyone for sensitive skin.

I love this product, finally something that feels good on my skin and doesn't break me out in small red bumps. It leaves a ever so slight white cast but honestly I just got it and I think I have to improve on my application technique. I love this please don't ever discontinue it.

A little greasy at first but it sets in nice, especially if your skin tends to be a little on the dry side. I have had ongoing skin issues with my face (yeast) so i cannot have anything too heavy/greasy and this does okay! It does have a sunscreen smell, which i dont mind but some might.

avis.titre: True Mineral Sunscreen, works with or without makeup
avis.texte: I love this Mineral sunscreen. It is thicker than most and does take 20 minutes to dry down. I do 2 applications to achieve that 2 finger rule. When I reapply a 2nd and 3rd time it does get oily but again I recommend waiting the full 15 minutes. After it dries down I do see some white caste but I'll gently rub it more into my skin. I wish Vanicream made a mineral, water resistant, no fragrance, spf. I recommend if you have sensitive skin or need a good reliable Mineral sunscreen. Please do not change ingredients.
I love the nighttime version (no SPF). This one leaves my skin drier than it is wirh no moisturizer. Skip this one!

Immediately after applying it, my entire face became itchy and felt like it was burning. I have sensitive skin and am always cautious about trying new products—but this is not it. It should not be advertised as suitable for sensitive skin. I do not recommend it.

Please don't ever change the formula or run out! This is the best moisturizer with sunscreen for my moody perimenopausal skin. I know some people don't like the thickness, but I love how hydrating and dewy it is, and it works really well under my makeup. I've tried other brands but always come back to this product.

I have rosacea, and this sunscreen has been wonderful because it does not irritate me and I believe it even calms down my redness a bit, is hydrating, has minimal white cast, but it does look greasy. If it included iron oxides for extra protection and was less oily, it would be perfect, but it's still my favorite sunscreen because it doesn't irritate me. I use it even though it makes me look greasy. It doesn't contain Butyloctyl salicylate, which makes it truly 100% a mineral sunscreen, which is great for my sensitive skin.

I would say this is an "ok" sunscreen for others but not for me. I have sensitive oily/acne-prone skin and I feel that this sunscreen is a little to greasy. It also kind of leaves a white cast but its only noticeable if you stare.
This is everything in one. It moisturizes without making me greasy or a weird color. And my favorite part is that it has spf 30 so it's perfect for everyday

I was on the quest to find a budget alternative to the Supergoop Mineral Sheerscreen I had been using for a while. I stumbled upon this, which is friendly for my sensitive skin in all the right ways and it even doubles as a moisturizer that includes 5 ceramides! Thus, I decided to give it a try, and I am so happy I did! This is even better than my previous sunscreen! It's cheaper, larger, less thick on my skin, more hydrating, better ingredients, does just as good underneath my makeup and it also doesn't leave as much of a white cast, but I rub it in good and don't usually notice a cast anyways with mineral sunscreens because I have pale skin. So please do yourself a favor if you have sensitive skin and don't mind a mineral sunscreen that's also a moisturizer and honestly a makeup primer for me as well :) By the way, I also have dry skin naturally so my skin drinks it, but this might be too thick for people with oily skin or combo.

I had to stop using chemical sunscreens because they would cause my eyes to water or sting. This is the first mineral sunscreen that doesn't pill on me. I have dry skin, and I think it feel wonderful, but I would imagine someone with lily skin not liking this product. I'm pretty fair, so white cast isn't something I worry about, but I imagine if you have darker skin you might need to spend some time getting this to rub in fully. I use this everyday on top of vit C, and have had some of the best skin of my life. I've used almost 2 tubes and am getting ready to buy a third.

Almost anything irritates my skin but not this rad SPF 30 by Vanicream. Best hydrating SPF. Goes on smoothly. It does look white at first but then fades out to your skin tone and it's very moisturizing. I used it everyday under makeup and alone as well. I'm on my fourth tube.
A little goes a long way. Blends in nicely. Recommended on Yuka app for clean beauty.

I have very fair sensitive skin, and this product works beautifully on my fair complexion. At the same time, I love the fact that it also includes ceramides to help the skin barrier -- and a fair amount of SPF. The texture is perfect for my mature winter-dry skin, and it works well under make-up. I do have a suggestion: This product would be even better if you also offered a TINTED version, which would eliminate the need for foundation or BB cream. Please consider adding it to your great line of products for sensitive skin. Thank you.
Loved this on my skin! Doesn't irritate or clog pores. Sits well under my foundation and doesn't pill or leave white marks.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: The formula is so dense it feels heavy on the skin. I know it's a mineral sunscreen but it leaves such a noticeable white cast. Don't even think about putting other products under because every single one I've tried has pilled off when I go to rub it in

I have very sensitive skin, vanicream is the only brand I have found that doesn't cause a breakout or dry out my very dry skin. the only con I have for this SPF is it is really oily the first 30ish minutes after applying, even on my very dry skin. I would purchase again though due to being the only product that hasn't caused a breakout or dried out my skin. I love that it is 100% mineral sunscreen as I am allergic to chemical ones.
it was very oily on my skin, left a white cast, and when i put makeup on top of it it made it very patchy

I wanted to love for the spf + moisturizer but it left my skin feeling sticky. I have dry skin. It felt like my skin wasn't absorbing it. It felt like no mather how mucb you rub it in it wont absorb. It also has a white cast, I usually never minded it but with this one I did.
My dermatologist gave me a sample of this and I fell in love with it. It makes my skin so soft. I was excited when I found that Ulta carries it!

It can be a better product. Brand claims to be for sensitive skin but this product needs a new formula. Eyelids need sunscreen too so I put on a small amount (smaller than a dime) and after about 10 mins my eyes get watery. White cast for me is manageable but for how this brand perceives to be great but not really

I bought this product because the regular version of Vanicream was out of stock. One week later I'm itchy and my skin is peeling like a lizard. DO NOT purchase this if you actually have sensitive skin.
Is great but does make me oily. Would recommend using a powder on top. Like the hourglass powder!

I used this product on sunny days instead of the daily facial moisturizer. I would use it after rosacea treatment with mocronozadol gel. I consistently fit do that the product dries put my skin. This doesn't happen with the regular daily facial moisturizer and I guess this is due to the zinc content. It also causes a grey/white hue on my medium - light skin, which I don't love but accept in favor of not using questionable uv blockers. Unfortunately the dryness is too unconfortable, but for particularly oily skin this might be perfect.
It's not an awful looking product compared to some mineral sunscreens but it's enough to make me want to try a better product for my skin.

I am a big fan of the Vanicream Moisturizer and Bar Soap for my sensitive skin, so I decided to give the SPF a shot. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this specific product from the brand. It has that very strong sunscreen smell & automatically burned my eyes. It is very thick & has a heavy white/blue cast that wont go away no matter how much you rub it in. I gave light skin and noticed the white cast, so I'm sure its way worse for medium-dark skin tones. It is sticky and leaves an oily finish. This isnt a product that can be worn under makeup easily without seperation. If you're looking for a sensitive skin sunscreen that you can slap on your face while at the beach & dont have sensitive eyes, then this might be okay. However, compared to Korean sunscreen I've tried, this one cannot compete.

avis.titre: Strong Sunscreen Smell & Major White Cast
avis.texte: I am a big fan of the Vanicream Moisturizer and Bar Soap for my sensitive skin, so I decided to give the SPF a shot. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this specific product from the brand. It has that very strong sunscreen smell & automatically burned my eyes. It is very thick & has a heavy white/blue cast that wont go away no matter how much you rub it in. I gave light skin and noticed the white cast, so I'm sure its way worse for medium-dark skin tones. It is sticky and leaves an oily finish. This isnt a product that can be worn under makeup easily without seperation. If you're looking for a sensitive skin sunscreen that you can slap on your face while at the beach & dont have sensitive eyes, then this might be okay. However, compared to Korean sunscreen I've tried, this one cannot compete.

avis.titre: Love the ingredients but oily finish
avis.texte: I love the simple ingredients in this new Vanicream sunscreen, love the wide tube, love the consistency of the product. I look for products containing squalane and this has it, however for a "non-greasy" formula it stays VERY oily looking on my face. It does not dry down on me. I tried it with my normal skin tint on top and powdered lightly but it still shows oily through the makeup and i dont love that. I used it as a body sunscreen and worked great on legs and feet for our beach trip, used it up that way and will not repurchase. I do love the daily moisturizer (without spf) and jt also contains squalane but sinks in better and does not have the greasy finish like this one does. I will for sure repurchase that one probably as a nighttime cream for over serums.

This all mineral sunscreen is super hydrating. The amazing formula with ceramides and glycerin really layer so wel over my cream that has b vitamins. I personally dont get a white cast however my skin is light and i use it as a main sunscreen so i still tend to add tinted sunscreen or foundation with zinc and titanium dioxide on top to give me more of a makeup look when i am doing a more full makeup look. Incredible. Wish it was sold in travel sizes or at least available in mini/travel size during the holidays.
Vanicream, thank you so much for making a simple SPF with minimal white cast. I will be a consumer of this for life. I have severe eczema so I thank you for your work for sensitive skin!!

avis.titre: oily but the only thing that has worked for me
avis.texte: I have had a huge amount of trouble with SPF irritating my eyes and this is the only one I've found that I can wear comfortably on my face. The texture is too oily for my taste but it has not actually broken me out. I am repurchasing because the comfort far outweighs me disliking the texture.
it left a white cast on my face, and did not seem super moisturizing
I love this sunscreen! Great texture. Blends in easily. Leaves a great glow that's not greasy.

I dont use mineral sunscreens on my face because of the dreaded white cast and how they dont absorb into my skin. But after trying this!!! It glides on like a moisturizer and doesnt leave a white cast at all for me. Theres no smell and doesnt bother my eyes.

I like it it does leave a white cast i do the three finger rule, the white cast fades as it melts into your skin but it is noticeable at first application. I am like light medium skin toned. It does give a glowy look borderline greasy but i do like it.

I like it it does leave a white cast i do the three finger rule, the white cast fades as it melts into your skin but it is noticeable at first application. I am like light medium skin toned. It does give a glowy look borderline greasy but i do like it.

I have to cross international borders to purchase this product, and I would do it again! It doesn't irritate my skin (sensitive, eczema and acne), nor does it make my makeup pill. It's not too creamy or runny, it's the goldilocks of textures for me.

I have tried so many sunscreens, and they all seem to be really irritating, chemical, and mineral. I really enjoy this sunscreen. I do put a layer of vanicream moisturizing lotion on my face before which helps prevent dryness. It be gives me a nice glow, and blends in well.I WOULD LOVE TO SEE A TINTED VERSION ;-) in multiple tones

Vanicream came through again for my sensitive skin and created a facial moisturizer with only zinc SPF. I have struggled to find a moisturizer for my daily routine that doesn't utilize chemical ingredients for their SPF. This creamy formula feels great on my skin and provides me with effective protection from the sun's harmful rays.
It's all zinc, non-nano, few ingredients, moisturizing and makes my skin look gorgeous! Please make a lip SPF to go with it!
I like this even better than EltaMD sunscreen. Thank you, Vanicream!

The good: For a mineral based sunscreen with 19% zinc oxide packed in, this wasn't whitening as much I thought it would be. The whitening effect was minimal and that was a pleasant surprise. It's also very moisturizing, true to its name and doesn't contain any iffy ingredients. Basically, the formulation is top notch. The bad: There's too much shimmer/shine from what I suspect is the amount of squalane in this. It's not a necessarily bad thing, but it can be mistaken for sweat and worse, it tends to highlight imperfections on the skin. Overall, it's a good sunscreen and moisturizer but I would need a more matte finish to buy again.

Just started using this product and I love it. I have been looking for a daily sunscreen but I have a gluten intolerance and darker skin so all the safe sunscreens I have tried give me a white cast. This is the only sunscreen that does not give me white cast! Thank you Vanicream for making this product!
All non-nano zinc oxide. Minimal ingredients. No irritating ingredients. Moisturizing. Blends in. Absolutely perfect! Don't ever stop making this please!

I am 66 years old. I have psoriasis, rosacea and am allergic to pretty much everything. I've never been able to wear moisturizer, especially on my face. I recently started using your Moisturizing Lotion (days), Moisturizing Cream (nights) and Facial Cleanser. They are all fantastic...they don't burn my skin or eyes. However this Mineral Sunscreen Face Moisturizer is too greasy and sticky. (For reference, I have found that CeraVe Ultra-Light Moisturizing Lotion spf 30 is completely non-greasy. Maybe you all can tweak this product?) But thank you for making great products with simple ingredients!
If I could give it a million stars I would. It saved my skin. I can finally wear a daily spf and take care of my dry sensitive skin. Best I have ever used hands down.
its so smooth and melts right into my skin without leaving a white cast. I absolutely love it and it's not my favorite sunscreen.

avis.titre: Finally an elegant non-nano mineral sunscreen!!
avis.texte: This product is the elegant non-nano mineral sunscreen I have been looking for for years! It is also non-comedogenic.I drained my FSA in the process of trying every non-nano mineral sunscreen on the market. They have to be somewhat thick to suspend the larger particles. This one is not too thick and blends out beautifully. Most minimal cast I've found for a non-nano sunscreen, I can wear many layers of this. Does not pill or ball. Does not feel heavy on the skin. Shiny, but to be expected with sunscreens. LOVE IT! I hope this sunscreen never gets discontinued as I will definitely be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Amazing for a Mineral Sunscreen Product!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is amazing! How? It's simply mon-whitening. This product also offer suitable hydration for the complexion with hyaluronic acid and more! This is THE best sunscreen product that Vanicream has ever offered. I do not shave every day, and even so upon application, I have zero white cast. Thank you Vanicream!

I have been looking for a mineral sunscreen without all the extra unnecessary ingredients for my sensitive skin. I have eczema and very dry skin. Zinc usually makes the dryness worse but this moisturizer is amazing! I rub it in really well and it doesn't leave a white cast at all! Love and will continue to use this.

I have honestly never been able to wear spf on my face because I reacted to everything! I purchased this daily spf lotion and went to the beach that day and my face did not get burned at all. The rest of me did. All I used was this lotion on my face and it lasted me the entire afternoon without having to reapply. Goes great under my powder foundation. I am in love.

While I will always appreciate Vanicream's approach to sensitive skin, this product was to thick and overly moisturizing for my skin. For reference, I have very sensitive, reactive skin with rosacea, prone to hormonal breakouts.

I was cautiously optimistic about a zinc oxide moisturizer that didn't have a white cast...and was pleasantly surprised! It gives me no discernable white cast, and is a nice, thick moisturizer that helps my combination skin - makeup sits really well without flakes. And love the clean formulation. New holy grail? Really hoping to see this in more retailers soon.

avis.titre: Not bad, but not good for me!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the original daily facial moisturizer, so I was excited to try this! It is not a bad product, but if you have oily skin I would not recommend. I find that the formula is way thicker than the original, and my skin does not like it, and gets more greasy than normal. However, initially it has good sun coverage, does not sting the eyes, and the white cast disappears in a few seconds. While I think the product is formulated well and a good option, I would not repurchase due to the thickness and my skin type. I have been using it on my chest so I can use the product up.
Have been using this as my everyday SPF and loving it. No pale cast and goes on smoothly! My new holy grail sunscreen. Please do not discontinue!
Fantastic product! No white cast and no irritation of any kind (I have acne and eczema prone skin). Please, please keep making sunscreens (I'll keep buying them) and don't discontinue this one.

avis.titre: Finally found what I was looking for
avis.texte: Just got this and can update once use more but can't even express how much loving this . I am pale so white cast ususally not an issue but none with this . This feels like luxury product but with a reasonable price . Have highly sensitive reactive aging (44 year old) acne prone ( thanks hormones ) skin that cannot take fragrances(even smells from my laundry detergent or cleaners for house had to get special products and even what I eat also can affect face- recently bok choy made skin itchy all over and as get older getting more sensitive than before ) or anything with too many ingredients even natural clean products sometimes can rash and/ or break me out . Found vanicream about 6 months ago and been loving lite lotion for face shampoo which stopped dry scalp that struggled with for you and even suggested to my mom who has has eczema on body and the vanicream cream helped her clear it so much as her skin is a little less sensitive as mine but still pretty sensitive . I have not tried daily facial cream mostly because didn't have sunscreen so was so excited to see this . My only question for squalane what is main of ( hoping not animal based since most time try to look for vegan when can ) . Going to look at daily facial cream since liked this so much and sunscreen for body . My only complaint that I love a bigger size option . I usually even inside reapply midday since near sunny window when work so would love this in bigger size of this . Thank you for a wonderful product a

If I could give this product 10 stars, I would! I'm absolutely obsessed with every product that Vanicream has to offer, but this one may just be my new favorite - especially for the summer! While it does smell like a sunscreen, it moisturizes and hydrates my skin, just as well as their cream, lotion or daily facial moisturizer does. It absorbs effortlessly, wears exceptionally well under makeup, and offers really great protection! I'm very minimalistic when it comes to my skincare routine, and I'm beyond thrilled that this is a 2-in-1 product!! Thank you Vanicream!!! You've done it again :)

I have been using the spf 50 on my skin but had hoped that a sunblock specifically for face would come out at some point. I am super sensitive, have rosacea, and get really red/flushed around my chin and mouth areas. This is very soothing and when I put it on my skin feels very calm. I love the weight of this moisturizer and there is no white cast for me with the zinc oxide. It's like I have nothing on which is heavenly. No stinging, burning, itching from this at all. This is my new favorite Vanicream product!
